what: Notes the launcher adds on deposits from its own reading of a line a reader flagged. Collected into defects.json for the repair pass.

notes.text: Philo quotation presented in quotation marks — "The name Jesus (Ἰησοῦς) is the name of the Logos." — attributed to De Mutatione Nominum §121–123 and Life of Moses II.114–132. As far as the launcher knows, Mut. 121 glosses Ἰησοῦς as σωτηρία κυρίου ('salvation of the Lord') and Mos. II.114–132 concerns the high-priestly vestments and the name on the plate; neither contains this sentence. Philo does name the Logos with many names elsewhere (e.g. Conf. 146), not 'Jesus'. The line reads as a paraphrase set in quotation marks. To verify against the Greek before repair; not changed.

Reader B0099 reports that #876 (OpenAIRE exchange) names a private helpdesk staff member in full. Under the standing rule (private individuals by initial in deposited texts; redaction re-derives the AXN), this is a candidate for initialing in the repair pass — to check: whether the exchange was public (cf. the #331 ruling) or private correspondence. RESOLVED 2026-10-15 by ruling: staff in official capacity are not private individuals; no change.
